---
title: "Daily Reports"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import os
from pathlib import Path

# Get reports directory
reports_dir = Path("../assets/reports")

# Get all date folders (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
date_dirs = sorted([d for d in reports_dir.iterdir() 
                   if d.is_dir() and len(d.name) == 10 and d.name[4] == '-' and d.name[7] == '-'],
                  reverse=True)

# Find latest report
latest_date = None
if date_dirs:
    latest_date = date_dirs[0].name
```

## Latest Report

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if latest_date:
    en_pdf = f"../assets/reports/{latest_date}/financial_report_en.pdf"
    print(f"**Report Date: {latest_date}**\n")
else:
    print("No latest report available")
```

## Past Reports

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if date_dirs:
    print("| Date | Chinese | English |")
    print("|------|---------|---------|")
    for date_dir in date_dirs[:30]:
        date = date_dir.name
        zh_exists = (date_dir / "financial_report_zh.pdf").exists()
        en_exists = (date_dir / "financial_report_en.pdf").exists()
        
        zh_link = f"[📥 Download](../assets/reports/{date}/financial_report_zh.pdf)" if zh_exists else "—"
        en_link = f"[📥 Download](../assets/reports/{date}/financial_report_en.pdf)" if en_exists else "—"
        
        print(f"| {date} | {zh_link} | {en_link} |")
```
